summary: ZeroStack Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a Securities Purchase Agreement with investors to issue 3.5 million shares and pre-funded warrants for up to 36.2 million shares, valued at $25.19 per share, in exchange for ~1 billion MemeCore tokens valued at $1.08 each, totaling ~$1 billion. The structure triggers Nasdaq shareholder approval for shares exceeding the 19.99% cap; warrants are locked up for up to ten years. Voting agreements with major investors support the approval. This is a digital-asset-for-equity transaction, not a classic special situation. Watch for shareholder approval, resale registration, and token value volatility.
